title: Subsequence of Size K With the Largest Even Sum
goal: Choose exactly k values with the largest possible even sum.
strategy: Start with the largest k values. If their sum is odd, any repair needs a parity-changing exchange; compare the cheapest odd-to-even and even-to-odd replacements.
